in_sanskrit.name: Qaiser
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victorious king
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Qaiser एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name of unknown origin, possibly derived from the Persian word 'Qaisar' meaning 'victorious'. In Hindu mythology, it could be associated with the god Indra, the king of the gods, who is often depicted as a victorious warrior.
